Before beginning a specific career in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], every young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of the tribe was required to take a '''Skills Test''', the result of which was then evaluated by the [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Ewok Council of Elders]], who would decide which career the young Ewok was best suited for. The Skills Test was a very important coming-of-age event in a young Ewok's life, and passing it was cause for celebration.

During the [[Rebellion era]], several notable Ewoks that passed the Skills Test were [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], who would continue on the path to becoming the future [[Chief/Legends|Chief]]; [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], who became a hoodmaker apprentice; [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], who would train to become a wizard; and the young scout [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who became a warrior apprentice.
